item.title: Conversion: IHG’s Voco to rise in Queenstown

item.title: Exclusive: Craig Bond promoted to Chief Operating Officer at Pan Pacific Hotels Group
item.description: HM can exclusively reveal Pan Pacific Hotels Group has appointed Craig Bond as Chief Operating Officer following a strategic internal promotion, reflecting continued investment in the company’s executive leadership team. item.title: Ascott boasts 27% year-on-year growth in new signings
